summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing the text of a Hong Kong Exchange announcement dated 20 August 2026, mirroring a US current report on Form 8-K. On 19 August 2026 the company granted conditional share awards over 286,184 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each under the HSBC Share Plan 2011 to employees and former employees at a nil purchase price, with the London closing price at grant of GBP 14.972. Vesting runs 33%/33%/34% over three years, longer for Material Risk Takers, with clawback and retention provisions. This is a routine employee equity award notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, advisor or regulatory clock apply.
